claim_text: Jemal et al. (2024) found that applying domain adaptation methods improved cross-subject epileptic seizure prediction accuracy by 10.30% on the CHB-MIT dataset and 7.4% on the SIENA dataset, compared to a cross-subject baseline without domain adaptation.
source_title: Domain adaptation for EEG-based, cross-subject epileptic seizure prediction
source_excerpt: the model accuracy has been notably improved by 10.30% and 7.4% for the CHB-MIT and SIENA datasets, respectively
label: VERIFIED
explanation: The claim accurately restates the paper's reported accuracy improvements from domain adaptation on both datasets, matching the abstract's reported figures exactly.
